pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pTurns dirt/cobblestone into Soil/Small Stone and can find dirty or damaged circuits. It produces raw circuits, not analysed boards.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Choose dirt or cobblestone according to the recipe.$p2. Supply the complete batch cost and wait through the duration.$p3. Separate guaranteed material output from chance-based circuit output.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pNot receiving a chip on every cycle is expected for chance results. Use Precision recipes when you need a more specific route.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
